header.title: About TenthMatrix
header.tagline: We build AI agents and generative AI applications for companies that outsource the work

content.description: TenthMatrix designs, builds and runs AI agents and generative AI applications for clients. Teams hand us the project. We deliver working software in their repository, connected to their systems, with a person approving anything risky.

TenthMatrix was split out of Workstation, which builds GPU workstations and clusters. Workstation kept the hardware. TenthMatrix took the software: the agents, the tools they depend on and the applications around them.

Ring Promoter, Proxy10x, WSL Vault, Jobshout, SysOps 24/7 and the Nebula family started as things our own agents needed in production. Client projects use them where they fit, and the client's existing tools where they don't.

We publish the engineering behind the work: architecture notes, the Jev benchmark series and write-ups of what failed. If you want to know how we would approach your project, the articles are a good place to start.
